description:
Start watching a brand name — the thing the whole product exists to do.

    Until now the connector could LIST a watchlist but never add to one, so an
    assistant could report conflicts and not act on the obvious follow-up. Optionally
    takes Nice classes as a comma-separated list ('9,42'); leave blank to watch every
    class, which is the right default when someone has not said otherwise.
name: watch_mark
title: Watch a name
